record.bible_text: But it came to pass within a while after<WH03117>, in the time<WH03117> of wheat<WH02406> harvest<WH07105>, that Samson<WH08123> visited<WH06485><WTH8799> his wife<WH0802> with a kid<WH01423><WH05795>; and he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, I will go in<WH0935><WTH8799> to my wife<WH0802> into the chamber<WH02315>.
